item.title: Warm, pleasant weather pattern takes over
item.description: Happy Saturday, Utah! The past couple of days have been cool and soggy, but this weekend marks the start of a shift in the weather pattern as high pressure takes over.

item.title: Man stabbed in throat during fight in Ogden, police say
item.description: A man was stabbed in the throat during a confrontation in Ogden Friday night, according to Ogden Police.

item.title: Man, woman in critical condition after West Valley City stabbings
item.description: A man and woman are in critical condition with multiple stab wounds after an incident in West Valley City Friday night, according to West Valley City Police.

item.title: Utah man arrested, charged with 26 felonies after allegedly sexually abusing stepdaughter
item.description: A Utah man has been arrested and charged with 26 felonies after his stepdaughter reported that he had been sexually abusing her since 2022.

item.title: Five arrested in connection with alleged theft operation at Home Depot in Cedar City
item.description: Five people were arrested on Friday, accused of taking part in a theft operation after an "extremely large quantity of stolen merchandise" from a Home Depot was found on a Cedar City property.

item.title: 11-year-old hospitalized after being struck by vehicle in West Jordan
item.description: An 11-year-old girl was hospitalized after being struck by a vehicle in West Jordan.

item.title: Utah rally highlights discourse surrounding U.S. military strikes on Iran
item.description: As the war in Iran continues, so does the political discourse in the United States. A new NPR, PBS, Marist survey found that while 56% of Americans oppose the U.S. military action in Iran, 44% support it.
